description: This file contains functional tests for the AccountController's sign-in related functionalities in an ASP.NET Core web application. It uses Xunit for testing and simulates user interactions like login, form validation, and profile updates.

classes.name: AccountControllerSignIn
classes.description: A test class that verifies the behavior of the account sign-in flow and profile update features in the application.

methods.name: ReturnsSignInScreenOnGet
methods.description: Tests that the login page loads successfully and contains a specific email.

methods.name: RegexMatchesValidRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Verifies that the regex correctly extracts a valid request verification token from HTML input.

methods.name: ReturnsFormWithRequestVerificationToken
methods.description: Ensures that the login form contains a request verification token.

methods.name: ReturnsSuccessfulSignInOnPostWithValidCredentials
methods.description: Simulates login with valid credentials and checks for a redirect to the root URL.

methods.name: UpdatePhoneNumberProfile
methods.description: Logs in, navigates to profile page, updates phone number, and verifies the change is reflected.
